trans-unit.note: Default legal wording for image labelling. As short as possible so it stays legible in small image sizes.

trans-unit.target: "%file%" is not a raster image (e.g. SVG). The label cannot be burnt into the image and will only appear as a text alternative in the markup.
"%file%" is too small at %width%×%height% pixels for a legible label. It will only appear as a text alternative in the markup.
